scheme.name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
scheme.source: PM SVANidhi official portal (https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in/, last updated 07-08-2026) and PM SVANidhi operational guidelines issued by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs. This is a hand-built local summary, not a live government API.

who: Street vendors vending in urban areas (municipal corporation areas and census towns)
Vending on or before 1 May 2020, or covered by a later Urban Local Body (ULB) survey
Covered under the Street Vendors (Protection of Livelihood and Regulation of Street Vending) Act, 2014
The shopkeeper's State/UT must have notified the scheme rules under the Act
documents: Certificate of Vending issued by the Urban Local Body, OR a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) if the vendor does not have a certificate
Identity proof (any one): Aadhaar, Voter ID, Driving Licence, PAN card, Ration card, or Passport
Residence proof of one year (address on ID or a utility bill)
Vending / business proof of one year
Own bank account passbook or statement
Mobile number linked to Aadhaar (needed for the online application)

loan_tiers.label: First loan
loan_tiers.requirement: First-ever PM SVANidhi working capital loan for an eligible street vendor

loan_tiers.label: Third loan
loan_tiers.requirement: Second loan repaid on time; the PM SVANidhi Credit Card is also available to vendors who repaid their second loan

terms.interest_subsidy_note: 7% per annum interest subsidy credited quarterly on timely or early repayment
